title: Fine Arts Travel Fee Schedule: Residency Shares for Non-Resident and Employee-Child Transfers (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a residency share of the travel fee applies under the Fine Arts travel fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, read from the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year (Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions).

| The enrollment record is | Residency share of the travel fee |
|---|---|
| a Non-Resident Transfer | 120 percent |
| an Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 80 percent |
| any other enrollment type, or there is no record in status enrolled for the school year | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical illustration:* on an amount of 110.00 the shares give 132.00, 88.00 and 110.00 respectively.
